title: 第994章 沈沧澜的心思第993章 开护山大阵
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
很快一个丈许大小的缺口，在护山大阵上缓缓出现。
这个缺口出现后，虽然其他部位依旧有阵法防护罩的保护，但秦怀安发现，整个护山大阵的防御力已是大幅下降。
精通阵法的秦怀安知道，不管什么阵法，只要有了缺口，就已经破坏了整个大阵的整体运行路线，尤其是防御类的阵法，对于大阵的完整性要求更为严格。当阵法出现缺口的时候，阵法的威力将会大大降低。
很多时候破阵，都是在找到阵法的某个薄弱部分之后，集中力量攻击这个薄弱部位，只要打开一个缺口，那这个阵法也就基本废了。
这也是道玄真人不敢轻易开启护山大阵的原因。
“怀安，快进来！我们必须马上恢复护山大阵。”阵法刚一打开，道玄真人就急切的朝秦怀安他们说道。
虽然秦怀安说他已经灭掉了天宝圣地在这里的驻地，不过道玄真人还是下意识的想要尽快封闭护山大阵。
毕竟，其他大域的宗门势力，就算不是那些超级宗门，一般的二流势力，也不是现在的紫荆圣地可以招惹的。
秦怀安看到谨慎的道玄真人，笑道：“道玄师兄放心，只要不是大罗金仙，现在没有人敢靠近我们紫荆圣地这里。”
“各位，随我进入紫荆圣地吧。”秦怀安朝身旁那些黄山剑宗弟子说道。
说着，秦怀安就带领这些黄山剑宗弟子从容不迫的进入了护山大阵之内。
在进入护山大阵入口的时候，秦怀安向着身后转头笑了笑。
看到秦怀安转头微笑，道玄真人一惊，“怀安，后面有人？”
此时秦怀安已经进入护山大阵，点头道：“有一些其他势力的仙尊大圆满修士，在远远的注视着我们。不过没关系，他们不会过来的。”
看到秦怀安等人都进入了护山大阵，道玄真人虽然还是迅速的挥舞控制阵法的阵旗，阵法缺口随着道玄真人阵旗挥动，短短数息时间就已经完全闭合。
不过，虽然阵法缺口已经闭合，但秦怀安稍微一感应，就知道这个阵法只是表面上闭合了。
阵法内部的能量还是快速的流转，想要恢复到原本的防御力，至少需要将近半个时辰的时间。
对于他们这个等级的强者来说，半个时辰时间，这个阵法早就被轰成渣了。
这并不是阵法本身的原因，而是道玄真人对于这个阵法的掌控力太弱的原因。
如果让秦怀安来控制阵旗恢复护山大阵，要比道玄真人快上数倍不止。

不过秦怀安并未说什么，只要段临川还没进入紫荆域，那天宝圣地那些人就不敢再过来。
至于其他势力的修士，看到天宝圣地的下场，他们又怎会轻易得罪秦怀安。
所以，现在这个护山大阵虽然恢复的比较慢，但对于紫荆圣地来说并没有什么影响。
秦怀安飞到道玄真人等人近前，抱拳行礼：“道玄师兄！”
道玄真人笑道：“哈哈，怀安你能从天宝圣地的追杀中逃脱，还能对天宝圣地造成如此巨大的伤害，很好！很好啊！”
秦怀安笑道：“呵呵，还好我修炼有些提升，这才没有让天宝圣地得逞。”
content_en:
Soon a gap about ten feet in size slowly appeared in the mountain protection formation.
After this gap appeared, although other parts were still protected by the formation shield, Qin Huaian discovered that the defensive power of the entire mountain-protecting formation had dropped significantly.
Qin Huaian, who is proficient in formations, knows that no matter what formation, as long as there is a gap, it will destroy the overall operation route of the entire formation, especially defensive formations, which have stricter requirements for the integrity of the formation. When there is a gap in the formation, the power of the formation will be greatly reduced.
Many times when a formation is broken, one has to find a weak part of the formation and then concentrate on attacking this weak part. As long as a gap is opened, the formation will be basically useless.
This is also the reason why Master Daoxuan dare not easily activate the mountain protection formation.
"Huaian, come in quickly! We must restore the mountain-protecting formation immediately." As soon as the formation was opened, Master Daoxuan said eagerly to Qin Huaian and the others.
Although Qin Huaian said that he had destroyed Tianbao Holy Land's station here, Master Daoxuan still subconsciously wanted to seal the mountain protection formation as soon as possible.
After all, the sect forces in other major regions, even if they are not super sects, are ordinary second-rate forces that the current Bauhinia Holy Land can't provoke.
Qin Huaian saw the cautious Dao Xuan and said with a smile: "Brother Dao Xuan, don't worry, as long as he is not Daluo Jinxian, no one dares to approach our Bauhinia Holy Land now."
"Everyone, please follow me into the Holy Land of Bauhinia." Qin Huai'an said to the Huangshan Sword Sect disciples beside him.
With that said, Qin Huaian led these Huangshan Sword Sect disciples into the mountain-protecting formation calmly.
When entering the entrance of the mountain protection formation, Qin Huaian turned his head behind him and smiled.
Seeing Qin Huaian turn his head and smile, Master Daoxuan was startled, "Huaian, is there someone behind you?"
At this time, Qin Huaian had already entered the mountain-protecting formation, nodded and said: "There are some Immortal Dzogchen cultivators from other forces watching us from a distance. But it doesn't matter, they won't come."
Seeing Qin Huaian and others entering the mountain-protecting formation, Dao Xuan quickly waved the formation flag that controlled the formation. As Dao Xuan waved the formation flag, the gap in the formation was completely closed in just a few breaths.
However, although the gap in the formation had been closed, Qin Huaian knew that the formation was only closed on the surface.
The energy within the formation is still flowing rapidly, and it will take at least nearly half an hour to return to its original defensive power.
For experts of their level, this formation would have been reduced to rubbish in half an hour.
This is not the reason for the formation itself, but the reason why Master Daoxuan's control over the formation is too weak.
If Qin Huaian were to control the formation flags and restore the mountain-protecting formation, it would be many times faster than Daoxuan Zhenren.
However, Qin Huaian didn't say anything. As long as Duan Linchuan has not entered the Bauhinia Territory, the people from Tianbao Holy Land will not dare to come again.
As for the monks from other forces, seeing the fate of Tianbao Holy Land, how could they easily offend Qin Huaian.
Therefore, although the current mountain-protecting formation is recovering slowly, it has no impact on the Bauhinia Holy Land.
Qin Huaian flew up to Master Daoxuan and others, cupped his fists and saluted: "Senior Brother Daoxuan!"
Master Daoxuan smiled and said: "Haha, Huai'an, you can escape from the pursuit of Tianbao Holy Land, and you can also cause such huge damage to Tianbao Holy Land, very good! Very good!"
Qin Huaian smiled and said: "Haha, fortunately, my cultivation has improved a bit, so I didn't let Tianbao Holy Land succeed."
